reason: Lint: two react/set-state-in-effect warnings are fixed by setting the state during render when its input changes. The overflow menu closes in the render where every item has come back inline (OverflowMenu:82), and the run-rule section ends its draft in the render where the stored rule changes, from the rule it last saw (RunRuleSection:113). Four new e2e tests pin the resets first: the overflow menu, the run-rule draft, View's rows and a strip's status line; the overflow and draft tests were seen to fail with the old effect switched off and to pass with the new form. View's row reset and the two status lines (RunStrip, TimetableRateChart) are left as they are: View's effect is not shown to be needed, and the new form would add a status line with its words already in instead of empty and then filled. npm run lint fails above 59 warnings (was 61). #625 item 5.
